title: Law to require air complaint portal in more languages
summary: This bill would require the Department of Environmental Protection to translate the Citizen's Air Complaint Program portal into the city's designated citywide languages for residents with limited English proficiency. It amends the administrative code provision governing the portal, which has seen complaints grow from about 9,000 in 2019 to over 163,000 in 2025. The law would take effect 180 days after enactment.
